def run(mod, seed=42, folds=(2017,2018,2019), val=True, verbose=False):

# REPORT — wser-effluent-exceedance--r3

Retrospective prediction under the release's stated assumptions. No holdout result is claimed; the holdout, source

## Result

| trial | what | validation AUC | Brier | evaluator backtest AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a92c4341 | scaffold baseline (unchanged `train.py`) | 0.89604 | 0.0884 | 0.8736 |
| 2702e136 | H1 regularization only | 0.90733 | 0.0853 | – |

| c50d7a35 | sensitivity: H4 without the four identification-snapshot attributes | 0.90752 | 0.0849 | – |

Release-documented references on the same validation rows: released full model 0.8993, calendar identity 0.8534,
persistence 0.8335.

Best eligible trial: `14237f1897274d4ab37885f3daa5c587`, validation AUC 0.908506, Brier 0.08478, fit 0.4 s.

## What the final model is

One `XGBClassifier` (hist, native categoricals), 800 trees, depth 3, lr 0.015, min_child_weight 20, subsample 0.7,
colsample_bytree 0.5, lambda 5, on the 15 declared predictors plus two row-wise derived features:

- `period_short` (periods reported in Y-1 below the count expected for the reporting frequency) and `monthly_like`
  (>= 11 periods) — exposure/consistency features built only from `periods_reported_prior_year` and
  `reporting_frequency`.
- Quebec `system_type` set to missing for every Quebec row (train and predict). In the training data Quebec stops
  reporting this field in 2019 (96% blank), so the mask makes earlier Quebec rows look like later ones.
- Monotone-increasing constraints on `prior_year_exceedance`, `prior_year_worst_margin`, `ever_exceeded_before`,
  `prior_year_acute_lethality_failures`.
- Interaction constraints: the four history features (prior flag, margin, ever-exceeded, history years) interact only
  with each other; the remaining features only with each other; `province` and `treatment_family` are in both groups.

No target encoding, no learned statistics other than category level lists, no date/ID inputs, no early stopping,
no use of validation in `fit`. `prepare` is purely row-wise (verified: evaluator row-by-row predictions equal local
batch predictions to 1e-16; row-order permutation gives identical predictions).

## Where the gain comes from (local 3-seed means; lab diagnostics, not eligible trials)

| config | rolling backtest AUC (2017/18/19 mean) | validation AUC |
|---|---|---|
| full H4 | 0.8873 | 0.90858 |
| minus Quebec mask | 0.8871 | 0.90843 |
| minus exposure-gap features | 0.8871 | 0.90784 |
| minus monotone | 0.8867 | 0.90854 |
| minus interaction constraints | 0.8864 | 0.90816 |
| minus all four (regularization only) | 0.8857 | 0.90717 |
| scaffold baseline | 0.8747 | 0.89604 |

About 0.011 of the 0.0125 improvement is plain regularization. The four structural changes together add ~0.0014,
each individually <= 0.0007. Those are below the uncertainty of the validation set (below), so they are supported only
by being directionally consistent in both the training-only backtests and validation, not by significance.

## Uncertainty

- Seed repeats (diagnostic, 10 seeds): validation AUC mean 0.90822, sd 0.00025, range 0.9078–0.9086. The recorded
  seed-42 trial (0.90851) is on the upper side of that range.
- System-cluster bootstrap on validation: AUC 95% interval [0.897, 0.920]; paired difference vs the scaffold baseline
  +0.0127, 95% interval [+0.007, +0.018].
- One-row-per-system sensitivity (200 random draws, 2,090 systems): AUC 0.9038 (sd 0.006).
- By target year: 0.919 (2020), 0.907 (2021), 0.900 (2022) — performance falls with distance from training, so a
  later period should be expected to score lower than the validation figure.
- 182 validation rows belong to systems absent from training: AUC 0.875 vs 0.909 for seen systems.
- Roughly 200 local configurations were compared against validation; the selected number carries selection optimism
  of the order of the seed noise.

## Findings

1. **The feature set, not the model, is the limit.** A 120-config random search is flat (0.905–0.908). A model trained

   pooled (diagnostic only; never used for the submitted model). There is no drift-specific headroom to recover.
